unit.why: An autobiographical memorate quoted from Zohar Hai (the Komarner): his ascetic youth, a test of his clairvoyance by a study partner, his cleaving to his uncle and teacher, and the persecutions he bore. It is framed by a short ethical instruction.
unit.boundary_note: One of a numbered series of excerpts from the author's writings; the previous and next divisions are separate excerpts.

stories.start_quote: בספרו זו"ח פ׳ ויחי בדפי הספר
stories.end_quote: דלא איעול בכסופא לעלמא דאתי עכ״ל
stories.summary_en: The Komarner recounts his ascetic, poverty-stricken nights of study, in which he could perceive the form of every tanna. He describes a study partner's test of his clairvoyant knowledge of people in Poland, which he passed and which a hasid who visited for the High Holidays confirmed. He then tells how he cleaved to his uncle, who taught him yihudim, and how humiliation by the wicked opened true spiritual attainment to him.

quotes: ולא הוחם בית החורף אפילו פ"א
tags.why: He abstains from worldly pleasure and studies in an unheated room.
Melancholy is named as the evil inclination's weapon, which Torah overcomes.

quotes: והייתי יושב ולומד מחצות לילה עד אור היום

tags.why: He endures poverty without feeling it, for the sake of Torah.

quotes: ואני אומר לך אם הוא תינוק מוטל בעריסה
ואמרתי לו לית דין בר נש
tags.why: He knows the appearance and occupation of people he has never met, and detects an invented name.

quotes: לראות את צורת התנא באורו על כל צורתו
tags.why: He sees the forms of the tannaim.
He describes mystical attainments disclosed to him.
His uncle taught him the holy yihudim.
Yihudim are a form of contemplative practice.

quotes: ועיקר התדבקות שלי הי' בדודי מורי ורבי הקדוש
tags.why: His bond with his uncle and master is central.
He states the need to cleave to the tzaddikim.

quotes: ואולי יכנע להיות נכנע לפני קוני
tags.why: Silent endurance and submission before God are presented as virtue.

quotes: ואל ישגיח כלל כי התורה תשמחהו
tags.why: Torah is said to bring joy that overcomes melancholy.

quotes: והי׳ אצלינו בשנה זאת על ימים נוראים
tags.why: The hasid came to spend the High Holidays with him.
The hasid retold the episode to his companions.

quotes: ובהיות עדיין לא נזדכך גופו יתרחק מאד
tags.why: The memorate is framed by an ethical instruction.

suffering persecution as a means to spiritual attainment
